title: Verify Sales Representative can open reports including financial data
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Sales Representative role. (this role has Reports ON and See Financial Data ON).
Report data exists.
steps:
1. Click Reports in the main navigation.
2. Open several reports, including the AR Aging report.
expected: Reports are accessible and open with financial data visible. No report returns a 403 error. (Known failure SV-7996: AR Aging report threw a 403 - retest.)
